inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README, Eleventy config, package scripts, site data, components, layouts, graph/search/backlink/filetree transforms, and sample published-note frontmatter

anchors.why: Identifies the repo as a Digital Garden Obsidian Plugin template with deployment through Vercel.
Defines Eleventy build/watch scripts and static-site dependencies.
Contains filters/transforms for links, tags, Dataview hiding, callouts, pictures, tables, and HTML minification.
Implements search, graph, filetree, backlinks/references, navbar, timestamps, link previews, and callouts.
Uses publication/path/permalink fields such as dg-publish, dg-path, dg-permalink, and permalink.

known_limits: The static site is a projection and must not become the canonical VAKS layer.
Publication gates must not leak private or candidate-only notes.
Graph/search/backlink UI is activation and publishing support, not reviewed relations or support evidence.
